title: VaatiCon
description: 🌌 Dark Magic to link minecraft server together withouth a proxy
body:
Vaaticon

🌌 Link server with dark magic 🪄

VaatiCon allow you to link two or more minecraft servers together **without any proxy**, using new mojang's **transfer packets**. # ✨️ Features 📚 Server Lists - go trought all registred servers in one click ✏️ `/server` and `/send` command like *Bungeecord* or *Velocity* (but it's still not ;) 📂 Ability to detect player's [server] origin (trought API Cookie) 📤 Automatically register/update own server to the database on start 💾 Works with **SQLITE** or **MySQL** # 📆 Comming Soon 🔐 Secure link between servers - only accept transfer from specific sever (private & public key) 📦 Easy way to send/retrieve data on tranfer using Cookies 🍪
